title: Kompas Studia
ogTitle: Kompas Studia · jakie studia w Krakowie?
description: A guide for Kraków high-school leavers: from what they like and are good at, to university study directions in Kraków and a plan of first small steps. Polish.
ogDescription: Około 20 minut pytań o to, co lubisz i co ci wychodzi. Na końcu kilka kierunków studiów w Krakowie, które pasują, i plan pierwszych małych kroków.
cardText: For high-school leavers choosing what to study in Kraków. About 20 minutes of taps and sliders about what they like, what they are good at and where it is needed, ending with a compass of matching study directions in Kraków and a plan of first small steps. Answers stay in the browser. Polish.
